title: Waivers and signed records

courseForms.heading: Course forms
courseForms.intro: Forms a course asks each student to sign as well as the release. Choose which ones on each course’s page.
courseForms.editDescription: Saving a change makes a new version. Students who signed an earlier one sign again.
courseForms.medicalScreeningHint: Signature only; no answers are screened. Keeps blocking boarding for a student who has not signed it, whatever the course forms setting.
courseForms.bodyPlaceholder: Paste the form’s full text here.

notice.unchanged: No change, so no new version
notice.invalid: That didn’t save. Give the form a title and at least a few sentences of text.
notice.deleted: Form deleted. Courses no longer ask for it; signed copies stay on file.
notice.notFound: That form is no longer here.

courseForms.needsTextDescription: Paste the agency’s wording for this form. No student is asked to sign it until it has its text.
courseForms.resignImpact: {students, plural, one {Saving a change asks # student} other {Saving a change asks # students}} on {sessions, plural, one {# upcoming session} other {# upcoming sessions}} to sign again.
courseForms.placeholdersHint: Write '{shopName}', '{courseTitle}' or '{instructorNames}' where the form leaves a blank for them; each is filled in when a student signs.

questions.heading: Your questions
questions.intro: Divers answer these after the medical questionnaire, before they sign. The answers go on the signed waiver and never hold anyone back from diving.
questions.alreadyAsked: DiveDay already asks for date of birth, an emergency contact, the certification card and agency, and a guardian for a minor. When they last dived is asked on each booking.
questions.optionalAdvice: Keep most questions optional. Each required one is another step for a diver signing on a phone.
questions.full: {max, plural, one {A waiver asks at most # question.} other {A waiver asks at most # questions.}}
questions.healthWarning: Health questions belong on the standard medical questionnaire, which refers a diver to a doctor when needed. For what the crew should know in an emergency, every release already asks for a medical alert for the crew. An answer here is never checked, never shown to the crew as a medical alert, and every staff member can read it.
questions.standardStays: It stays as it is. Every diver answers it before your questions.
